plainTranslation: Jupiter square Pluto: Jupiter square Pluto, there can be too much fighting between you, too much struggling over power and control, and you can get stuck in the dark side of the relationship.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
